overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Gracia Elite 1-2 Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Constructed from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna features 7 ultra-low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels strategically placed to provide soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, it includes a chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized, spa-like experience. With its easy clasp-together assembly and clear tempered glass door, the Gracia Elite combines elegance and functionality for your ultimate relaxation.
